notes.title: Update to cutscene animations
notes.content: Lots of feedback was given for us to work on the cutscenes. There are lots of improvements to the character on this update. More to come in the future as well.

notes.title: Small Menu Bug Fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue which prevented passing the first few menu screens.

notes.title: Huge Update (Almost at completion)
notes.content:
[h1]You can now download the latest demo playtest[/h1]

[b]Improved Cutscenes[/b]

Enhanced cutscenes with improved cinematography and smoother transitions.
Updated dialogue animations for a more immersive storytelling experience.

[b]Improved Lighting, Animations, and Atmospheres[/b]

Refined lighting effects across all environments for enhanced visual fidelity.
Upgraded character animations for more natural movements and interactions.
Atmosphere adjustments to deepen immersion and evoke a richer gaming experience.

[b]Bug Fixes and Better UI[/b]

Resolved various bugs and glitches that impacted gameplay and stability.
Streamlined user interface for easier navigation and more intuitive controls.
Improved Performance

Optimized game performance across all platforms, resulting in smoother gameplay and reduced loading times.

[b]New Mobs[/b]

Introducing new challenging mobs with unique abilities and behaviors to diversify gameplay encounters.
Better Flow of the Game

[b]Improved Flow[/b]
Implemented gameplay adjustments and refinements based on community feedback.
Enhanced balancing of difficulty levels and progression mechanics.

Improved pacing and progression to maintain a seamless and engaging gameplay experience.
Refined level design to ensure a more cohesive and enjoyable journey through the game world.

[b]Getting Close![/b]

We're excited to announce that we're now 90% complete with the game! Stay tuned for the final stretch and launch details.
Additional Notes

Stay connected with our community for further updates and announcements leading up to the full release.
Your continued feedback is invaluable as we work towards delivering the best possible gaming experience.

Thank you for your support and dedication to our game!

notes.title: UI Fixes, Small Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Based on feedback, we've made a few things extra clear. We also fixed the playtime counter bug! 

The bonus mode is now also complete and playable.

We are now ready to officially launch our actual demo, and remove the play test version.

Thank you to everyone who has participated!

notes.title: New Features, and Minor Fixes.
notes.content:
- New latching features for enemies. You can now break free by performing a meter stop movement. Getting a perfect meter zone will kill the enemy with a head bash.

- Extra enemies and polishes

- Minor bug fixes.

- Minor UI fixes.

- Minor light fixes.

- Demo now has a proper ending area.

notes.title: New World Elements
notes.content:
The world is now full of brain disgusting matter! You are in the mind, after all.

We've also enabled a fun bonus mode:

"Journey into the heart of the Scraper's birthing lair. 

Expect fierce resistance from various Scrapers, each with unique abilities and attack patterns.

Arm yourself with advanced weapons and explosives designed to destroy the mounds, disrupting the Scraper reproduction cycle."

notes.title: Demo Beta Release!
notes.content:
We're elated to share that we are releasing our official demo candidate build here for play testing. Once we hammer out some play testing, we will release our official demo, based off of this build!

The changes, if you missed them:

[b]1. Revitalized Levels:[/b]
Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world as we've re-lit and re-colored every level, ensuring a captivating and vibrant gaming experience.

[b]2. Diverse Enemies, Unique Abilities:[/b]
Encounter new challenges with the introduction of multiple enemy types, each wielding unique abilities that demand strategic thinking and adaptability.

[b]3. Expanded Arsenal:[/b]
Arm yourself with a diverse array of new guns, each designed to bring a fresh dynamic to your gameplay.

[b]4. Extended Playable Areas:[/b]
Embark on an even more extensive adventure! We've added numerous playable areas, effectively doubling the length of the game for a richer gaming experience.

[b]5. Deeper Lore and Storyline:[/b]
Unravel the mysteries of our game with a significantly expanded narrative. We've invested time in explaining the story more thoroughly, ensuring a more immersive and engaging experience.

[b]6. More Cinematics, More Drama:[/b]
Brace yourself for jaw-dropping cut scenes that add cinematic flair and depth to the unfolding story.

[b]7. Crystalline Sound Quality:[/b]
Your in-game world just got an auditory upgrade! We've revamped sound quality to elevate the impact of every shot and explosion.

[b]8. Formidable Boss Battles:[/b]
Confront two new bosses with unique mechanics, providing a challenging yet thrilling test of your gaming skills.

[b]9. Dialogue-Rich Areas:[/b]
Engage with characters on a deeper level as we've expanded dialogue-rich areas, allowing you to become even more immersed in the game's narrative.

[b]10. Sleek UI and Main Menu:[/b]
Experience a smoother and more intuitive journey with a revamped user interface and main menu.

[b]11. Enchanting Musical Scores:[/b]
Let the game come alive with a suite of new music tracks, specially composed to enhance your gaming atmosphere.

[b]12. Visual Marvels:[/b]
Enjoy improved textures, visuals, and environments teeming with intricate details and nuance.

[b]13. Bug Squashing Bonanza:[/b]
We've combed through every nook and cranny, addressing bugs to ensure a seamless and enjoyable gaming experience.

[b]14. Worldwide Reach:[/b]
For our global player base, we've introduced localization for different languages, breaking down barriers and making our game accessible to an even wider audience.

ːsteamthumbsupː

We're particularly proud of the progress we've made in explaining the game's story in greater detail, providing players with a deeper understanding of the immersive world they inhabit.

Your support and feedback have been our guiding lights throughout this journey. As we continue to evolve, we're committed to delivering an unparalleled gaming experience.

Thank you for being part of our community!

Stay tuned for more thrilling updates!

Best regards,
The Devs!

notes.title: Your Feedback Has Improved The Game!
notes.content:
[h2]Introduction[/h2]
We are thrilled to present the latest update for our game, packed with a range of fixes, enhancements, and improvements to elevate your gaming experience. From addressing bugs to improving the storyline and incorporating player feedback, we have worked diligently to enhance your enjoyment of the game.

[h3]Gameplay Update[/h3]
- Replaced lantern with flash light. This allowed the game to open combat up in dark areas, and gave us the ability to create areas with zero lights, or very dark lighting.
- Redesigned m9 pickup area for gun to not be so easily missed.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Camera and Transitions:
- Fixed camera transition issue from the church to the podium puzzle room.
- Adjusted the camera transition from the library to the church black cube to ensure proper positioning.
- Resolved the bug where the camera transition went through the floor when entering the hatch from Kane's estate.
- Fixed loading which would crash, due to issues with equipped weapons.

[h3]Visual and Graphic Fixes[/h3]
- Improved FPS by optimizing character model and lighting in all levels.
- Replaced volumetric beams on cars in cutscenes.
- Resolved clipping issues with the fat scraper and shed in the forest outer woods.
- Fixed face glitches in the detective office cutscene.
- Improved road surface appearance after getting out of the car.
- Improved lighting for outside church area, and various other areas.
- Fixed Lynn's stutter steps at the end of her walking animation in the lab.


[h3]Mechanics[/h3]
- disabled all input when confirming a load.
- Adjusted aim sensitivity based on player feedback.
- Smoother transitions.
- Resolved culling issues on fixed cameras in the forest tunnel.
- Fixed blood effects when scrapers or the player gets hit.
- Resolved blendshape issues in the lab scene.
- Fixed issue causing baby room sad music to play simultaneously with chase music.
- Fixed collider issues in the lab scene that allowed player movement.

[h3]UI and Interface Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed the visibility of notice icons for campfire and telescope
- Ensured opacity of the load menu is 100% when opened.
- Made setting values auto-save.
- Added skip option in the pause menu in cutscenes.
- Improved the size and legibility of the resolutions drop-down menu.
- Adjusted the placement of connection time in the load/save menu screen.
- Removed room titles in maps to avoid confusion.

These bug fixes aim to enhance the overall gameplay experience by addressing issues that impacted visual fidelity, mechanics, UI elements, and player immersion. We appreciate your support and hope you enjoy the improved game performance.

Stay tuned for future updates.
